goal: Stop unconfirmed wallet transactions from being resubmitted when private broadcast is enabled
Prevent nodes from leaking their identity as transaction senders or receivers over clearnet
agreement: Unaddressed objection: removing rebroadcast drops useful functionality and needs a general fix (polespinasa)
Objection: coupling rebroadcast to private broadcast contradicts docs and disables a wallet feature (vasild)
Supports preventing unexpected rebroadcast of wallet-associated transactions over clearnet (andrewtoth)
Simple fix that is suitable for backporting (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an origin privacy leak when private broadcast is configured
Serving an evicted transaction that no other peer holds marks the node as its origin

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it keeps the wallet from violating user privacy expectations under private broadcast
Prevents incoming dust or dropped transactions from triggering unexpected rebroadcasts
